name: Are there different glass options for skylights, and do they affect performance?

mainEntity.name: Are there different glass options for skylights, and do they affect performance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, skylights offer various glass options that significantly impact performance. Common choices include standard clear glass, insulated glass units (IGUs) for better thermal performance, and low-emissivity (Low-E) coatings that reduce UV light and heat gain without sacrificing visible light. For areas prone to hailstorms or where safety is a concern, tempered or laminated glass provides greater impact resistance. Your choice of glass affects energy efficiency, UV protection, noise reduction, and overall comfort within the space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Skylight glass options include clear, insulated, and Low-E for thermal performance and UV reduction, plus tempered/laminated for impact resistance. Glass type affects energy efficiency and comfort.
